name: Tailscale Services
desc: Application-aware connectivity that gives a backend service its own tailnet identity.
desc_zh: 应用感知的连接方式，让后端服务在 tailnet 里拥有自己的身份。
solves: Reaching an internal service means pinning it to one machine's IP, which breaks the moment that machine moves; Services gives the workload a stable name of its own.
solves_zh: 访问内部服务只能绑到某台机器的 IP，机器一迁移就断；Services 让这个工作负载拥有自己稳定的名字。
best_for: You are wiring two internal services together and do not want to hard-code the host they happen to run on today.
best_for_zh: 要把两个内部服务接起来，又不想把今天恰好跑在哪台主机上写死的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://tailscale.com/blog/sitemap.xml）。 Rule-(b) candidate: GA on 2026-02-19, before the window, and not in the ledger (the ledger holds only Tailscale@2020-04-02).
